scenario: Multiple `after` clauses per rule per LTAC.4.3: a rule with `after 1_s:` and `after 2_s:` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so the two timer schemas are not observed. That each fires independently needs a run.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule multi_timer:
    Trig t where t.v > 0
->
    log info "start"
    after 1_s:
        log info "first"
    after 2_s:
        log info "second"
